summary.en-US: Translate text inside images on X, Pixiv, eHentai, and ordinary web pages.
summary.zh-CN: 翻译 X、Pixiv、eHentai 与普通网页图片中的文字。

description.en-US: ShinobuTranslator detects, recognizes, translates, removes, and typesets text inside images. Local image processing runs in the extension; configured translation providers receive only the data described in the privacy policy. Source: https://github.com/DonutShinobu/ShinobuTranslator Privacy: https://github.com/DonutShinobu/ShinobuTranslator/blob/main/PRIVACY_POLICY.md Support: https://github.com/DonutShinobu/ShinobuTranslator/issues
description.zh-CN: ShinobuTranslator 可检测、识别、翻译、去字并重新排版网页图片中的文字。本地图片处理在扩展内完成；仅按隐私政策向用户配置的翻译服务发送所需数据。源码：https://github.com/DonutShinobu/ShinobuTranslator 隐私政策：https://github.com/DonutShinobu/ShinobuTranslator/blob/main/PRIVACY_POLICY.md 支持：https://github.com/DonutShinobu/ShinobuTranslator/issues

version.approval_notes: Build with Node.js 22: npm ci && npm run build-for-amo. The command verifies pinned model size/SHA-256, builds dist-firefox, enforces 0 Firefox lint errors, and packages source. Detailed reviewer steps are in apps/extension/amo/reviewer-notes.md. Test popup persistence, page image controls, Alt+Q/Alt+W, context menus, local pipeline host idle/recovery, install-time authentication/Cookie consent, and direct Gemini Cookie login without a second permission prompt.
